The polypropylene (PP) is ejected at near-sonic speeds through a high-pressure hot air stream via a narrow slit in an air chamber. The melt is ejected from micropores in the spinning process, held and stretched by the high-speed airflow, and after cooling, forms ultrafine fibers with a diameter of only 1-5 μm (micrometers).
